summary: video-dialog Vue component (scoped, data-v-949ad85e). Props src and iframeSrc; data isMobile from $isMob. It renders div.video-container with mob/pc classes containing either a <video class="video"> (controls, autoplay, inline-playback and x5 player attributes, preload auto) when src is set, or an <iframe class="video video-frame"> (1280x720, allowfullscreen) pointing at iframeSrc.
